en: What if phones had never been invented?
zh: 如果從來沒有發明電話，會怎麼樣？

en: I asked Grandma. She said, "When I was little, we wrote letters... and waited for days!"
zh: 我問奶奶。她說：「我小時候都寫信……然後等好幾天！」
say: I asked Grandma. She said, when I was little, we wrote letters... and waited for days!

en: So I looked around. My phone is a map, a camera, a clock, and a flashlight!
zh: 我看看四周。手機是地圖、相機、時鐘，還是手電筒！

en: No phones means paper maps, knocking on doors, and running for help.
zh: 沒有手機：看紙地圖、去敲朋友家的門、有急事要跑去找人。

en: Then I found out: the telephone was invented in 1876. Before that, people sent letters, and even pigeons!
zh: 我發現：電話是1876年發明的。在那之前，人們寫信，還用鴿子送信！
say: Then I found out: the telephone was invented in eighteen seventy-six. Before that, people sent letters, and even pigeons!

en: Slower? Yes. But maybe we'd look up and talk more. What do you think?
zh: 會變慢嗎？會。可是我們也許會抬起頭，多聊聊天。你覺得呢？
